definition: Mohammad Emad Mostaque (Bengali: মোহম্মদ ইমাদ মোশতাক; born 17 April 1983) is a British-Bangladeshi businessman, mathematician, and former hedge fund manager.
details: Funded and catalyzed the open-weight release of Stable Diffusion, accelerating the open-source generative AI ecosystem. He is the founder of Intelligent Internet and the author of The Last Economy. He is the co-founder and was CEO of Stability AI until March 2024, the company behind Stable Diffusion.
